name: Nilachal Refractories Limited
about: Nilachal Refractories Limited provides refractory products in India. The company offers fireclay, alumina, high alumina, tar impregnated and tempered, mullite, and special bricks; and regular dense, medium cement dense, low cement dense, self-flowing, pumpable and shotcreteing, and insulating castables, as well as regular and low cement gunning, low cement gunning, and plastic and ramming. It also provides refractory mortars and coatings, and wet mortars. The company also serves cement, copper, glass, aluminum and petro-chemical industries. The company was formerly known as IPITATA Refractories Ltd and changed its name to Nilachal Refractories Limited in August 1999. Nilachal Refractories Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Kolkata, India.
